ST-5
STARTING - STARTER
DISASSEMBLY
1. REMOVE FIELD FRAME WITH ARMATURE FROM
MAGNETIC SWITCH ASSEMBLY
(a) Remove the nut, and disconnect the lead wire from the
magnetic switch terminal.
fl00545
(b) Remove the 2 through bolts.
800::'23
(c) Remove the 2 screws and end cover from the field frame.
(d) Remove the 0-ring from the field frame.
(e) Using a screwdriver, hold the spring tank back and dis­
connect the brush from the brush holder. Disconnect the
4 brushes and remove the brush holder.
(f) Pull out the field frame from the magnetic switch assem­
bly.
(g) Remove the O-ring.
r-r.,73:t:12
